core: Urea cycle citrulline and arginine synthesis
name: Urea cycle citrulline synthesis and OTC deficiency
rationale: All members concern ornithine transcarbamylase-centred citrulline/arginine synthesis in the urea cycle; the OTC leader and main-chain deficiency variants separate it from C1/C3, and the biosynthetic terms separate it from C2's other urea-cycle enzyme deficiencies.

qualifier: NHEJ/HR choice, ADP-ribosylation, genotoxic drug and topology stress
name: Double-strand break repair with ADP-ribosylation and genotoxin response
rationale: Members cover sensing and repair of double-strand breaks (classical/alternative NHEJ, HR regulation), PARP-type ADP-ribosylation and responses to break-inducing drugs; the NHEJ and ADP-ribosylation terms separate it from C2/C4, and the drug responses (bleomycin, camptothecin, cisplatin, hydroxyurea) and DNA topology terms separate it from C1/C3.

qualifier: cancer receptor/SMAD mutants and RUNX3 targets
name: TGF-beta superfamily SMAD signaling, cancer mutants and RUNX3 targets
rationale: All members concern TGF-beta/activin/BMP/AMH receptor-SMAD signaling and its regulation; cancer mutants of TGFBR1/2 and SMADs plus RUNX3-driven targets separate it from C1/C3, and the broad TGF-beta/BMP/activin regulation separates it from the RUNX3-centred C2/C4.

core: Muscle sarcoplasmic calcium release and extrusion
name: Muscle calcium release and extrusion in cardiac relaxation
rationale: Members concern ryanodine-receptor calcium release, Na/Ca exchange and cytosolic calcium reduction controlling muscle contraction; negative regulation of heart rate and contraction plus cardiac relaxation separate it from C3/C4 (positive force and rate), and release/extrusion rather than SERCA-ATPase regulation separates it from C1/C2.

name: Centrosome and spindle positioning for oriented cell division
rationale: Members concern microtubule nucleation and anchoring at the centrosome, centrosome localization, astral microtubules and spindle orientation; spindle orientation and asymmetric division separate it from C3/C4, and the absence of cytokinesis (C1) or centriole duplication (C2) terms is reflected in the positioning focus.

name: Osteoblast commitment from mesenchymal progenitors via RUNX2 and Wnt
rationale: Members concern mesenchymal stem cell differentiation into osteoblasts and its positive/negative regulation by RUNX2, Wnt, BMP and mechanical load; the RUNX2, Wnt-antagonist and osteocyte mechanosensing terms separate it from the cartilage-heavy C1, mineralization/collagen C2 and osteoclast C3.

qualifier: SERCA uptake regulation, caffeine-sensitive release, ER store depletion
name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium uptake and release control
rationale: All members concern moving calcium into or out of the SR/ER store (SERCA-ATPase regulation, ryanodine-receptor release, Na/Ca exchange); SERCA uptake regulation separates it from C1/C3, caffeine response and Na/Ca exchange from C2, and ER store terms without cardiac contraction from C4.

name: Cardiomyocyte sarcolemma, junctions and integrin-ILK adhesion
rationale: Members concern cardiomyocyte membrane architecture and its electrical/adhesive coupling (T-tubules, rafts, caveolae, gap junctions, cell-cell adhesion, action potential); integrin and PINCH-ILK-parvin focal adhesion terms separate it from all confusables, which are sarcomere and contraction themes.

qualifier: MHC class I and KIR recognition
name: NK cytotoxicity regulated by MHC class I recognition
rationale: Members concern activating and inhibitory control of NK and cytotoxic lymphocyte killing; KIR cluster, MHC class Ib presentation and protection from NK killing separate it from C2/C3/C4, which carry T cell proliferation and activation, and from C1, a CD4/dendritic cell theme.

name: Folate one-carbon metabolism and methionine salvage
rationale: Members concern folate/tetrahydrofolate and formate one-carbon interconversion feeding methionine and SAM (with folate-linked neural tube closure and histidine catabolism); folate terms separate it from C1/C4 and methionine salvage separates it from C2/C3.

qualifier: Wnt ligand secretion and calcium branch
name: Wnt ligand secretion and Wnt/calcium non-canonical signaling
rationale: Members concern Wnt ligand production and secretion (PORCN, biogenesis) and the WNT5A/calcium non-canonical branch; secretion terms separate it from C1/C2 and the calcium branch separates it from the canonical C3/C4.

name: Dendritic arbor, filopodia and postsynaptic actin remodeling
rationale: Members concern actin-driven shaping of dendrites, spines and the postsynapse; filopodium and RHOF terms separate it from C2/C4 and postsynaptic density and receptor transport terms separate it from C1/C3.

name: Epidermal morphogenesis and skin barrier formation
rationale: Members concern keratinocyte development, cornified envelope assembly and barrier establishment in skin; epidermis and sebaceous gland morphogenesis separate it from confusables built on keratinocyte proliferation control, cornification and UV response.

qualifier: direct alkylation reversal and glycosylase defects
name: Base excision repair and direct alkylation damage reversal
rationale: Members concern removal of damaged bases by glycosylase-initiated BER (including OGG1/MUTYH/NTHL1/NEIL1 defects and long-patch gap filling) and MGMT/ALKBH direct reversal; direct reversal separates it from C1/C4, glycosylase defects from C2 and long-patch BER from C3.

name: Tyrosine, proline and glycine-glyoxylate amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members concern synthesis and catabolism of specific amino acids; tyrosine/phenylalanine catabolism separates it from C1/C3/C4 and proline, glycine and glyoxylate terms separate it from the phenylalanine-focused C2.

qualifier: Hartnup, SLC1A1 and SLC6A14 transporter defects
name: Plasma membrane amino acid transport and Hartnup-type defects
rationale: All members concern amino acid uptake across the plasma membrane and inherited transporter defects; Hartnup (SLC6A19) and tryptophan terms separate it from C1, and SLC1A1/SLC6A14 variants separate it from C2-C4, which carry iminoglycinuria and peptide transport instead.

name: Ventricular trabeculation and cardiomyocyte proliferation
rationale: All members concern formation of trabecular ventricular myocardium through cardiomyocyte proliferation and development; it lacks the compact myocardium, atrial, endocardial and coronary terms of its confusables.

qualifier: DNA methylation, imprinting and X inactivation
name: DNA methylation, imprinting and facultative heterochromatin silencing
rationale: Members concern DNA methylation, PRC2/histone demethylation and heterochromatin formation underlying imprinting and X inactivation; the confusables are broad chromatin-modifier collections (BAF, NuRD, HAT/HDAC, histone methyltransferases) that this theme lacks.

name: Olfactory receptor odorant and pheromone sensing
rationale: All members concern smell via olfactory receptors and responses to odorants and pheromones; the confusables are taste perception themes.

qualifier: RHOA/B/C and CDC42 subfamilies, formin activation
name: Rho and Cdc42 subfamily GTPase cycling
rationale: Members are GTPase cycles of RHOA/B/C, CDC42, RHOG, RHOJ and RHOD with formin effectors; RHOA/B/C separate it from C1/C3, and the absence of RND/RHOU/V (C2) and RAC (C4) cycles keeps it to Rho and Cdc42 subfamilies.

name: Adenylate cyclase inhibition via alpha-2 adrenergic Gi/Gz signaling
rationale: Members concern GPCR control of adenylate cyclase, chiefly inhibitory Gi/Gz coupling from alpha-2 adrenergic receptors; direct adenylate cyclase regulation separates it from the secretion-focused C1/C4, and adrenergic Gz inhibition separates it from the PKA (C2) and muscarinic/purinergic (C3) themes.

name: Heme-to-bilirubin clearance and inherited hyperbilirubinemias
rationale: Members cover heme degradation to bilirubin, its hepatic uptake by SLCO transporters, UGT1A conjugation and ABCC2 export with their disease defects; heme degradation and hyperbilirubinemia terms separate it from the drug ADME/xenobiotic confusables.

core: Host defense against bacteria at epithelia
name: Epithelial bacterial attachment, invasion and Gram-positive defense
rationale: Members concern bacterial adhesion to and entry into epithelial cells (InlA-mediated Listeria entry, actin-based motility) and mucosal defense against Gram-positive bacteria; the invasion terms separate it from confusables built on defensins, phagocyte killing and Mtb manipulation.

core: Replication-associated DNA damage checkpoint and repair
name: Fanconi anemia interstrand cross-link repair and intra-S checkpoint
rationale: Members concern the Fanconi anemia pathway (monoubiquitination/deubiquitination), interstrand cross-link repair and intra-S checkpoint signaling; Fanconi and monoubiquitination terms separate it from all confusables, which focus on HR synthesis, fork reversal or topology stress.

name: Growth plate chondrogenesis and skeletal joint morphogenesis
rationale: All members concern chondroblast/chondrocyte differentiation, proliferation and hypertrophy in cartilage development; joint morphogenesis separates it from C1/C4, and condensation/cartilage morphogenesis separates it from C2/C3, which instead carry articular cartilage homeostasis and ossification.
